question: What experiences do iPhone 11 buyers report when using SIM cards with different carriers?
answer:
One buyer reported that their iPhone 11 apparently wasn't unlocked and that T-Mobile could not make it work, so they sent it back. [28fea4ddc839_0]
Another buyer said their telephone provider told them the SIM was blocked and that the phone would not allow their SIM card to activate, so they planned to return it. [53900d615ed6_0]
One buyer reported the phone came fully unlocked, worked on Verizon, and accepted the SIM card from their old phone right away. [c08c415e2809_0]
A Verizon customer of 35 years said the iPhone 11 had much better reception than the iPhone 13 they returned. [6aaae0e346fb_0]
One buyer said Boost Mobile would not allow them to use their SIM, so they switched phone companies and kept their number. [409f0aaddf97_0]
Another buyer said they put their T-Mobile SIM into the phone and it started working with data without needing activation. [47420d11ff7c_0]

chunks.text: IPhone 11 vs IPhone 6. Sent back. Apparently wasn't unlocked, carrier (t-mobile) could not make it work.

Seller needs to be more detailed. The iPhone 11 does not allowed to activate the SIM card. We went to our telephone provider and they told us that the SIM is block. I called our telephone provider and technician indicated that this phone is not allowing our SIM card to activate. I do not think this phone is fully unlock to use it. So I am going to return it to the seller and hope they need to fix this issue so that customers are not wasting their time and money.

DID COME UNLOCKED!!!. Amazing condition, came dead but fully unlocked, using it on Verizon, great price, and I was really scared it wouldn’t work, especially for under $400 but it pulled through guys. I got the iPhone 11 in black and I used the SIM card from my old phone and it worked right away.

Better Reception. The iPhone 11 has much better reception with Verizon which has been my carrier for 35 years. I purchased the 13 iPhone with the promotion and could not get a call out, or in. Within the 15 days I return the 13 iPhone and the iPhone 11 works just as well if not better for reception, and all the features. I’ve had four, five, 7/8, and upgraded to the 13. Big mistake the 13 iPhone has so many problems and issues. Thank you for the good phone that I have now, my renewed iPhone 11

iPhone 11 unlocked. [[VIDEOID:d6d6dbf7030351f88d9583f8427eaa8b]] The only thing is I had to switch phone companies but the phone works great.! Since Boost mobile changed ova it wouldn’t allow me to use my sim so I just changed services and took my number with me.!

Overall no issues at all. I LOVE MY IPHONE 11! I bought my iphone 11 from here and i was a bit nervous, i’ve never purchased a phone outside of a phone store so i had my concerns. I read many many reviews on amazon and found this to be the best reviews. I am not disappointed! My screen is not cracked/not scratched, battery life is good, the camera is astounding and I adore the color! I highly recommend purchasing your phone from here. The only hang up I had was getting it set up with verizon, phone issues are never simple however so i kind of expected that. The customer service struggled with switching over my account to another account though, so that has nothing to do with the phone itself. Phone works great on verizon service!
iPhone 11. Phone is in great condition and works great. No issues with setting up with carrier.

Great purchase. I bought this iPhone 11 to replace my son’s SE. I usually buy refurbished for my kids because, well, they’re kids. They can buy new if they want when they grow up and get jobs. Anyway, we had no problem setting up the phone except for the cellular service. The box came with a tool for a SIM card which I thought must be standard but thought the old SE phone didn’t have a SIM. I was wrong. We took it to the Verizon store and the customer rep took less than a minute to change the SIM card to the new phone and we were all set. All data transferred seamlessly. So far, a great experience and everyone is happy.

The iPhone review. My iPhone came with a big scuff on the corner (aluminum frame) and a small (not really noticible) scratch on the front and back of the phone. I got the 64 gb product red unlocked iPhone 11 which was, I believe a Verizon unlocked phone. My phone came in the iPhone 11 apple box with a original apple charger and original apple brick. When I set up my phone I just put in my T-Mobile sim and the phone started working with my data. I did not need to get it activated or anything.

It is scam. Beware!!!!. [[VIDEOID:fbc1203d7c2fe4ea0ea5daeb4bc011]] I purchased this iPhone 11 because it said it was unlocked. I have always owned unlocked iphones and never had troubles with them. I live in Guatemala. This iPhone 11 was working for a few days but all of the sudden "stopped" recognizing my SIM card. As you can see in the video the issue is not my SIM card because it works in my old and unlocked iPhone 8. Since I am not in the USA I lost almost $600. Beware, don't buy this product. It is a complete scam.
